10. LANDLORD'S RIGHT TO REPOSSESS FOR PERSONAL USE

That the Lessor, as a bona‑fide claimant, may terminate this Agreement and recover possession of the Premises for his own personal use, and any resistance by the Lessee shall be deemed obstruction under CPC 1908 — Section 99.
